in_marathi.name: Harshitha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Harshitha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Harshitha is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Harshita' which means 'to be pleased' or 'to be delighted'. This name is believed to be derived from the Goddess of prosperity, Lakshmi. In Hindu mythology, Lakshmi is the goddess of wealth, fortune, and prosperity. Harshitha is a name that signifies happiness, joy, and prosperity.
